entities.title: knowledge-driven-development
entities.summary: The canonical statement of knowledge-driven development, a documentation convention for repositories built mostly by agents, now superseded by human-assisted software development.
entities.purpose: Holds the convention that repositories which adopt it link to instead of restating it: the README with the four marks and the rules that matter most, the six numbered documents (01-methodology.md to 06-enforcement.md), and a starting file per document kind in templates/. Meta/Agents/ holds the skills and knowledge catalogue the .dev folders follow.
boundaries: The convention is about other repositories' documentation. This repository is exempt from its own greps: every mark in it is an example or a definition, not a claim about a system.
The reasoning behind the convention is in a five-part series on icelander.net, not here.
Meta/Agents/Skills and Meta/Agents/Knowledge are copies from the human-assisted-software-development repository, changed there and copied here.
